The Four-Phase Journey

Each phase keeps earning while the next one switches on.

LUMA is not four businesses — it is one business getting brighter. Lightboxes fund the showroom, the showroom unlocks LED, and LED earns the credibility for landmark installations. Nothing is replaced; every layer compounds.

Phase 1 · The Foundation

Lightbox Advertising

Start high-volume and low-cost. PVC and aluminium lightboxes build cash flow and a client base; rotating cubes on monthly rental become the first recurring-revenue machine. Premium signs come only after the margins are proven.

01 · Core · High volume

PVC Lightbox Boards

Backlit sign boards with printed flex inside a PVC/aluminium frame — the everyday sign for every kirana, salon, clinic and café in Kerala. Lowest cost of entry, highest demand, fastest to install.

Your cost₹800–6K
Sell price₹2.5K–18K
Margin55–70%
02 · Premium standard

Aluminium Frame Lightbox

Slim anodised profile with snap-open front and a far cleaner look. Single- and double-sided versions — the double-sided hanging units command a 40–60% premium. The choice of cafés, hotels and IT offices.

Your cost₹1.5K–12K
Sell price₹5K–35K
Margin54–72%
03 · Hero · The MRR machine

Rotating / Turning Cube

A motorised cube that turns at 1–2 RPM with 3–4 illuminated faces — visible from 20m+. Offered on a ₹4K–8K/month lease: the client pays monthly, LUMA owns the asset, and recoups cost plus profit inside a year.

Sell price₹25K–75K
Rental / mo₹4K–8K
Margin63–70%
04 · Phase 1B · After Month 6

Premium Acrylic & Silver

Edge-lit transparent acrylic that glows across its whole face, mirror-finish silver boxes and CNC custom shapes. Introduced once the client base exists to sell into — these go viral on Instagram and become LUMA's signature.

Sell price₹8K–80K
Margin60–70%
Core philosophy

Lead with volume to build cash and credibility. Layer premium and rental on top. By Month 12: 30–40 active clients, 8–10 rotating cubes earning monthly, and the proof needed to open a real showroom.

Phase 2 · Physical Expansion

Showroom & Premium Products

With 30+ clients and steady cash flow, LUMA opens a walk-in showroom on the MG Road corridor — a gallery of glowing signs that closes deals nothing else can. A new premium tier brings European studio quality to Trivandrum prices.

→ New channel

Physical Showroom

A walk-in space where clients see and touch products lit up in real life. In Kerala's trust-based culture, a glowing ₹40K mirror box in person converts 10× better than a WhatsApp photo.

→ New tier

Premium Custom

Custom-shape acrylic, chrome mirror boxes, illuminated menus, dichroic signs — inspired by London studio Lightabox, delivered at 40–60% less cost.

→ New clients

Hotels & Corporate

The studio gives the credibility to approach Leela, Marriott and Technopark firms. One lobby order can equal twenty PVC board sales.

Phase 3 · From Signs to Media

LED Advertising Panels

An LED panel doesn't just display a brand — it plays video, cycles multiple clients and earns 24 hours a day. This is the product that turns LUMA into a media company. And in Trivandrum, almost nobody is doing it well yet.

3–12 ft
Panel Range
72%
Gross Margin
₹8–20L

3
Revenue Streams
01 · Entry · Retail & hospitality

Floor-Standing Totem

Slim 3–5ft portrait LED on a steel stand. Plays MP4, slideshows or live apps via built-in player — no laptop needed. Affordable enough for a café, high impact, easy install. The fastest-moving SKU in Phase 3.

Your cost₹25K–45K
Sell price₹60K–1.1L
02 · Volume · Highest visible ROI

Outdoor Roadside Panel

IP65 weatherproof, 5000–7000 nits for full sunlight. Replaces a flex banner that's reprinted every 6 months, so the 3-year ROI sells itself. Own one, place it at NH66, and sell 4 ad slots for ₹40K/month passive.

Your cost₹80K–1.8L
Sell price₹2–4.5L
03 · Flagship · Corporate & Govt

Large Format Billboard

Billboard-grade modular cabinets stacked to any size, 6500+ nits, remote 4G/WiFi content. One order equals 30–40 Phase 1 lightbox sales. Targets mall rooftops, highway junctions and Smart City displays.

Your cost₹1.8–3.5L
Sell price₹4.5–10L+
04+05 · The goldmine · Recurring

Managed Content + Ad Network

Every panel needs fresh content: sell monthly plans at ₹3K–8K (70–80% margin). Then own panels at premium junctions and sell slots to 6 advertisers — ₹60K/month per ₹1.5L panel, payback in 3 months.

CMS / panel₹3K–8K/mo
Owned panel₹40–60K/mo
◷ Open market

First-mover pricing

Trivandrum has near-zero professional LED operators. Full-colour video panels are still a novelty here — early movers capture premium pricing.

◷ Built-in demand

Govt-driven

Smart City, metro corridor signage and KTDC tourism displays are all actively seeking LED vendors. Phase 2's track record lets LUMA bid.

◷ Warm base

Same clients

The cafés, hotels and corporates from Phases 1–2 are the exact buyers for LED panels. No new audience needed for the first 6 months.

Mega LED & Kerala Futurism

From lightboxes to landmark installations that define Kerala's skyline. Giant billboards bring revenue, naked-eye 3D panels create viral moments, and Government smart-city partnerships turn LUMA into a nation-level name.

01 · Core revenue driver

Mega LED Billboards

4×6m to 8×12m, P6–P10, 6000–8000 nits on wind-load-certified steel for the Kerala coast. Six advertisers per screen on a 60-second loop, premium peak-hour rates, and full-screen takeovers for launches.

Unit capex₹25–60L
Rev / screen₹1.5–4L/mo
Target8–12 units
02 · Kerala-first · Viral

3D Anamorphic Panels

Corner-wrap LED playing anamorphic content — objects appear to leap into real space, no glasses needed. Kerala has zero naked-eye 3D screens as of 2026. Every campaign ships with drone footage built to go viral.

Capex₹1.2–2.5Cr
Revenue₹8–18L/mo
Target2–3 units
03 · B2G · Landmark design

Smart City Installations

LED junction towers, illuminated gateway arches, smart bus shelters and programmable building façades for KIIFB, Smart City Mission and ULB contracts — turning LUMA into Kerala's go-to urban-installation vendor.

Project size₹50L–5Cr
Margin35–50%
Priority locations

Where the screens go

Kazhakootam / Technopark (35K+ IT employees, first 3D site), Vellayambalam (Secretariat — B2G visibility), Pattom (premium audience), Thampanoor (80K+ daily) — then Edappally and Marine Drive in Kochi.

Test50K+ footfall · 50m sightline
The compounding effect

Phases 1–3 keep generating ₹8–12L every month while Phase 4 launches. LUMA is never starting over — it is layering a new revenue engine on top of a profitable base.
